637: (5) Borrowed: As it is written: all citizens in Israel shall live in booths (Leviticus 23:42). [Since the spelling of booths in the verse indicates a singular booth,] it teaches that the whole Jewish people is fit to sit in a single booth (meaning one after the other). But this is impossible for all of them, since there is not enough for each one to own the worth of a perutah [a small coin] of it, unless it is done by borrowing [it].
